transcript: Speaker A (Woman): ఆఫీస్ లో అందరూ మాట్లాడుకుంటున్నారు, నీ ప్రమోషన్ ఇంగ్లీష్ వల్లే పోయిందని. on_screen_text: SpeakX app. Just ₹2 per day, 7 days trial.
summary: A man regrets losing a promotion due to poor English. His colleague recommends the SpeakX app, sharing how its AI teacher helped her improve in 10-15 days for just ₹2/day.
